'''Alalved''' will be the clan chief of the [[Tomanelle]] Aiel seen by [[Aviendha]] in the [[Glass columns]] of [[Rhuidean]].

Seventeen years after the [[Last Battle]] Alalved attends the meeting where the Aiel decide to go to war with the [[Seanchan]] where he points out that the Aiel were excluded from [[The Dragon's Peace]].
